summary: Comprehensive testing of Gatewise Enterprise CLI completed successfully. All requested CLI commands work correctly including status (Community/Enterprise), parse, validate, apply --dry-run, help, and license tiering verification. CLI demonstrates proper Factory pattern for BYOI, Kubernetes connector integration, and license management.
